en.headline: Two workers injured as 800kg iron tubes roll down slope in Ma Tso Lung
en.dek: A female and a male worker were struck by a bundle of iron tubes during site investigation works near Lok Ma Chau on Friday afternoon and airlifted to hospital.
body: Two construction workers were injured on Friday afternoon when a bundle of iron tubes weighing about 800 kilograms rolled down a slope at a site investigation works area near Ma Tso Lung in Lok Ma Chau.

Police received a report at about 4.19pm that two workers had been hurt on a slope. Rescuers found a 53-year-old woman surnamed Lo with injuries to her chest and leg, and a 52-year-old man surnamed Wong with injuries to his back and head. Both remained conscious and were taken by helicopter to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.

According to reports, the site was preparing for foundation works. A helicopter had been lifting a bundle of about 60 iron tubes, each six metres long, when the load fell and rolled down the slope, striking the two workers. The case was classified as an industrial accident involving injury.

zh.headline: 落馬洲馬草壟斜坡鐵通滾落 兩工人受傷直升機送院
zh.dek: 周五下午近馬草壟勘探工地，一紥約800公斤鐵通滾落斜坡擊傷兩名工人，傷者清醒由直升機送往東區醫院。
body: 周五下午，落馬洲近馬草壟一斜坡勘探工地發生工業意外，一紥鐵通滾落斜坡擊傷兩名工人。
警方下午約4時19分接報，救援人員到場發現一名53歲姓盧女工胸口及腳部受傷，以及一名52歲姓王男工背部及頭部受傷。兩人仍然清醒，由直升機送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院治理。
據了解，現場正進行勘探及準備打地基工程，直升機吊運約60支各長6米、合共重約800公斤的鐵通到場時，鐵通意外倒下並滾落斜坡，擊中兩名工人。案件列作工業意外有人受傷。
